business.name: RD Amazing
business.about_short: A Dammam print house for every kind of paper and plastic print, and maker of printed paper cups, with luxury finishes worthy of your brand.

hero.title: We print luxury
hero.lead: Design, print, finishing and packaging under one roof in Dammam, for prints that carry your name and stay in your client's hand.

acts.label: Design
acts.title: Every luxury print starts with a considered line
acts.text: We sit with you on the idea and turn it into a print-ready file: size, margins, stock and colours, before ink ever touches paper.

acts.label: Print
acts.title: Colours that come out as designed
acts.text: Carefully calibrated colour, so maroon stays maroon and beige stays beige from the first copy to the thousandth.

acts.label: Finish
acts.title: A touch you can see and feel
acts.text: Hot foil in beige and gold, embossing, laser cutting and coloured edges: details that keep your print in hand for longer.

acts.label: Delivery
acts.title: Delivered wrapped, as it deserves
acts.text: Every order is wrapped with care and delivered on time across Dammam and the Eastern Province.

why.title: Every stage under one roof
why.text: Design, print, finishing and packaging in one place, so your order never gets lost between suppliers.

why.title: Your brand colours, exactly
why.text: We match your logo colours and show you a proof before the full run.

why.title: Luxury finishes
why.text: Hot foil, embossing, spot UV and coloured edges, for prints you can see and feel.

why.title: We make the cups
why.text: Printed paper cups in your design for cafés, restaurants and events, from manufacturing to print.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Send us your idea or file on WhatsApp.

steps.title: Design and approval
steps.text: We prepare the design and a proof and sign it off with you.

steps.title: Print and finish
steps.text: Produced with the stocks and finishes we agreed.

steps.title: Wrap and deliver
steps.text: We wrap your order and deliver it on time.

faq.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.a: Send us the product, quantity and size on WhatsApp and we will reply with a clear quote during working hours.

faq.q: Do you design, or do I send a ready file?
faq.a: Both. We design with you from the idea, or print your file as it is after checking it for print.

faq.q: Which file format is best for print?
faq.a: A high-resolution PDF in CMYK with a 3 mm bleed, or the open design file.

faq.q: Do you show a proof before the full run?
faq.a: Yes, we send you a proof to approve before producing the quantity.
In Dammam, and we deliver across Dammam and the Eastern Province.
